description: Sources describe Paygent, an AI-agent billing product, not the NMI-powered Paygent Connect payments gateway.
auth_notes: Documented API for a different Paygent product uses pg_live_ keys sent as Bearer tokens; not confirmed for Paygent Connect.
gate_detail: Sources cover the wrong product. That product has a free tier with no credit card required, but this says nothing about Paygent Connect (NMI) access.
api_scope: Sources describe a REST API for plans, users and subscriptions of an AI usage-billing product, not payment gateway APIs.
mcp_notes: No MCP server for Paygent Connect appears in the sources.
blocker_detail: All sources document a different Paygent (AI agent billing), so Paygent Connect (NMI) developer access cannot be established.

evidence.quote: Authentication: Bearer token in Authorization: Bearer pg_live_... header.
The Paygent backend exposes a small REST API.
No credit card required to start.
Design realistic plan tiers for your product, submit them via the API, and update them as you learn.

uncertainties: Sources describe a different Paygent product, not NMI-powered Paygent Connect.
Auth, access and webhooks for Paygent Connect are not established.
